note: The scoreboard board generator (tools/scoreboard/board.py) reads this file: the assurance label and the two mandatory prose cells per panel (exploration 03 §3.6, §4). A panel with a control_file gets real numbers; one without is a placeholder row. Both prose cells are mandatory — the generator fails when either is empty.

assurance_labels.design target: no Lean definition answers this panel yet (theorems about the kernel may exist in world/); the panel is measured by the control only
assurance_labels.executable property: a property checked by running a Lean definition on the panel (#eval or a compiled reader), with no theorem behind it
assurance_labels.conditional: a Lean theorem about the kernel with an explicit premise (for example injective ids, or a coverage premise), and the panel is scored by running that same definition
assurance_labels.proved: a Lean theorem about the kernel with no premise beyond the model's own definitions, and the panel is scored by running that same definition (hash-tied to the build)
assurance_labels.cross-language: the claim crosses a seam the theorem does not cover: the Lean model on one side, a deployed minidregg host or a non-Lean reader on the other

scope.decision.measures: ReadScope parsing (parse vs rule refusals), the visibility decision `Compiled::visible` on (id, origins) inputs, `is_unrestricted`, and the sources×paths `origins` crossing — the decision-test families of ekos/crates/ledger/src/scope.rs, answered by EKOS's own functions on 59 items from 17 tests.
scope.decision.does_not_measure: anything inside a store (the ScopedStore wrappers: filtered reads, both-ends relationships, evidence gating, counts, diff, search, write refusal — that is the scope.store panel); MCP/CLI scope enforcement end to end (the RFC 0181 leak suite needs the fixture pipeline, no control exists yet); the scope fingerprint's equality behaviour across scope changes.

conflicts.unit.measures: the detectors `duplicate_definitions`, `merge_losses`, `label_mismatches` and `normalize_type` (ekos/crates/semantic/src/conflicts.rs): type-alias normalization, duplicate collapse (incl. silent and per-attribute), permutation-invariance with stable conflict ids/claims/signature, exact vs fuzzy merge losses, label mismatch exclusion rules — 16 items from 8 tests.
conflicts.unit.does_not_measure: the conflicts review workflow (`resolve`, `carry_forward`, `column_links` — reviewing, not detecting); conflict persistence (EKOS prints conflicts, it does not store them); fixture-scale conflict finding (conflicts.ledgersmb needs the LedgerSMB demo pipeline, not built).

scope.store.measures: ScopedStore — the RFC 0181 store wrapper — over a real (temp SQLite) Ledger built through ekos_ledger's public API: the eight store tests of scope.rs:1041 on as ordered step scenarios — filtered object/relationship/history/at/fact/audit reads, both-ends relationship visibility, evidence gating through visible objects, search and retrieval filtering, scoped counts and diff, write/event/vacuum refusal, multi-scope intersection and set_scopes replacement.
scope.store.does_not_measure: the MCP/CLI surface over a compiled project (the read_scope.rs leak suite: marker words through every tool shape, the result cache, --read-scope flag and process scope) — that needs the fixture pipeline (run_fixture.py), not built; the every_store_method_has_a_decision_here meta-test (source inspection, nothing to replay); scale (the world is four objects).

ledger.ecommerce.status: controls committed and wired into regen_controls.py's LEDGER_REGISTRY (W20): the ledger dump opens the workspace's fact store READ-ONLY (.ekos/ledger/facts) and regen runs it twice byte-identically against the committed control like every other entry; no expected file — the workspace is the expectation source, and the EKOS#10 fork away from this control is classified ekos_defect in controls/classified.jsonl (diff_id 07e3cb27…)
ledger.ecommerce.measures: the six-stage ekos pipeline (init, build, recover, resolve, compile, commit --yes) on ecommerce.sql through the release binary in a scratch workspace: the graph export ndjson (8 nodes — 2 File plus exactly the 6 Tables the integration test counts — and 6 ForeignKey edges), the EKL object and relationship rows sorted by id, status and conflicts json, pinned by a sidecar (binary sha256, EKOS commit, fixture sha256, per-stage timings); plus the versions control (controls/ledger.ecommerce.versions.control.jsonl): per object (sorted by id) the id, kind, name, version count (object_history length), a locally recomputed content signature per version (content_signature is pub(crate); created_at stripped here, hashed by ekos_artifact's own ArtifactId::compute — with a no-evidence variant that isolates EKOS#10) and every version's evidence id list, the workspace totals, and diff(epoch, now) as a sorted id list; two signature self-checks (adjacent versions must differ; get_object must equal the last history version) falsify a wrong recomputation
ledger.ecommerce.does_not_measure: relationship version history (only its count in totals — objects only; the EKOS#10 fork's relationship half is inferred from entry arithmetic, not pinned per relationship); events and session objects; edge properties (a pending SameAs is still invisible); object properties beyond what the signature hash covers; the MySQL/docs/git fixtures (not run); the ledger's own byte layout (the control pins logical content, not segment bytes)

ledger.northwind.does_not_measure: relationship version history (only its count in totals — objects only; the EKOS#10 fork's relationship half is inferred from entry arithmetic, not pinned per relationship); events and session objects; edge properties (a pending SameAs is still invisible); object properties beyond what the signature hash covers; the MySQL/docs/git fixtures (not run); the ledger's own byte layout (the control pins logical content, not segment bytes)

identity.unit.measures: DefaultResolver::resolve on named objects (ekos/crates/identity/src/lib.rs): merge proposals as member sets with exact_name_match and confidence, SameNameDifferentKind conflict groups against the five expected-coexistence narrowings, structurally-keyed Custom-kind exclusion through the ekos_kir::custom_kinds registry, and the name_for_similarity rules (Table schema qualifier, GitHub owner/repo#n prefix) — 58 items from 45 tests.
identity.unit.does_not_measure: the structural_score columns/rows signals on their own (four not-transcribed test families, a future structural-score panel); the stats/threshold/serde API tests; every_pipeline_custom_kind_is_registered (walks the EKOS source tree, no object inputs); merge execution (resolve proposes, the ledger merges — that is branch.unit); fixtures-scale resolve.

branch.unit.measures: merge_branch over two real temp SQLite ledgers (ekos/crates/ledger/src/lib.rs:1621): clean additions from branch, content-signature no-ops for identical objects (created_at stripped before hashing), and same-id diverged objects recorded as conflicts rather than overwritten — 3 items from the 3 merge_branch tests.
branch.unit.does_not_measure: relationship merging (no transcribed test appends a relationship, so that half of merge_branch is unmeasured); objects removed in branch (EKOS never looks for absences); three-way merges; evidence propagation into main; persisted conflicts (the report only, EKOS does not store them).

impact.unit.measures: the Runtime graph walks (ekos/crates/runtime/src/lib.rs) over a real temp SQLite ledger: load_neighborhood and load_neighborhood_bounded (truncation reporting, no dangling edges after a cut), trace_impact both directions with kind filters and hop bounds, dependents()/related(), the pending-review exclusion (unconfirmed SameAs), the RFC 0151 session-memory exclusions, and the RFC 0144 doc-mention rule — 26 items from 15 tests.
impact.unit.does_not_measure: named_graph_ops_respect_direction_edge_kind_and_hops and the kind-prefilter test (not walk-shaped items); the relationship-read session filters outside these walks (session_edges_are_absent_from_every_relationship_read_path); search-quality aspects of dependents ranking; fixture-scale graphs (needs run_fixture.py).

redact.unit.status: panel and expected outcomes committed (W15: 26 items from 16 tests); no control dump subcommand yet, so EKOS's own answers have not been recorded
redact.unit.measures: (when the dump exists) redact / redact_json / is_excluded_path from ekos/crates/common/src/redaction.rs on the inputs of its own 16 unit tests, including extra patterns and excluded globs.
redact.unit.does_not_measure: policy completeness: a secret of a shape the pattern table does not name is not caught and will not be claimed (design §10); planted fixture strings (not transcribed); the two readers that skip redaction (EKOS#18, #19) are entry-point defects, not redact-function inputs.

ekl.parser.status: panel and expected outcomes committed (W16: 50 items from 26 parser tests); no control dump subcommand yet
ekl.parser.measures: (when the dump exists) the EKL parser on the query strings of its own tests: AST fields the tests assert (entity, predicates, returns, order, limit, AS OF, GROUP BY, SEMANTIC) or the error kind.
ekl.parser.does_not_measure: AST fields a test does not assert (only asserted fields are in the expected file); the fuzz test (asserts only no panic); REASON/Datalog.

ekl.interpreter.status: panel and expected outcomes committed (W16: 33 items from 32 interpreter tests); no control dump subcommand yet
ekl.interpreter.measures: (when the dump exists) the EKL interpreter over each test's own small world: rows, counts, groups, UnknownField refusals.
ekl.interpreter.does_not_measure: three AS OF tests with no fixed timestamp (not reproducible as data); queries against fixture-scale ledgers (the real `ekos ekl --json` binary over run_fixture.py workspaces is the planned second family); SEMANTIC retrieval quality.

placeholders.measures: (planned) as-of cuts with relationship validity windows stated separately from domain time.
placeholders.does_not_measure: domain time semantics beyond the stored windows.
retrieval relevance (the retrieval_eval harness is search quality, not a Fusion panel).

never_measured_here: search relevance (BM25/vector quality) — design §10 will not claim it
model-pass quality (evals/datasets agent+retrieval runners) — LLM-dependent, not a kernel input
SQL/parser coverage breadth — parsing is untrusted (design §4, §10)
Events — no control available in M0.5 (no lister; exploration 03 §2.4)
